name: Key On
senseiLine: Practice your kata with your instructor.

steps.text: Step forward w/RF, pivot on the balls of feet, face L w/RF in rear, LH downward block (protect (L) front leg), RF step forward, RH straight forward punch

Raise RH fist (across body) to L ear, look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward, followed by RH downward block (over RL), LF step forward then LF straightforward punch
question: Q2

steps.text: Raise LH fist (across body) to R ear, while (short) stepping to rear w/RF into cat stance, step forward w/LF into front stance, LH downward block (over LL) then RH straight forward punch.
question: Q10

steps.text: Raise LH to L ear, then step w/RF, end facing R, w/ RF forward, LH reverse inside block, step forward with LF then RH reverse straight forward punch
question: Q7
Q9

steps.text: Raise RH to R ear, look over L shoulder then 180- degree turn w/LF leading, end facing L w/LF forward, RH reverse inside block, step forward with RF then LH reverse straight forward punch
question: Q8

steps.text: LF Step back into cat stance (now facing forward, then forward w/RF followed by RH downward block (over RL), then LH reverse straightforward punch
question: Q11

steps.text: Pivot to the L, LF forward, LH overhead block, next “catch” both hands on the R hip followed by RF straight forward kick, after kick, place RF down in front and follow with RH straightforward punch

Look over R shoulder then 180- degree turn w/RF leading, end facing R w/RF forward, RH overhead block, next “catch” both hands on the L hip followed by LF straight forward kick, then place LF down in front and follow with LH straightforward punch
Pivot (to face rear) into front stance w/RF in front, RH downward block protecting RL, step forward w/LF followed by LH straightforward punch (kiai/spirit yell)

finish: Bring LF 180 degrees into (front facing) ready stance, move to attention & bow out
